lena: quick roundtable  need a launch post + webinar that ties our benchmark story to SDR routing. target: mid-market infra/platform buyers.

jen: keep post short: 3 bullets (econ, tail latency, private options) + link to appendix. appendix = 3 charts + methodology.

omar: language: comparative (vs unmanaged endpoints / typical LLM APIs). avoid competitor names. add a note on model/config context.

mike: webinar plan: 20m total  8m bench story, 6m demo (fallbacks & cost dashboard), 6m Q&A/customer micro-case. CTA: request dedicated trial.

sam: inbound routing: tag leads by intent (proof-seeker, compliance, cost-eval). route to tailored SDR playbooks. I can draft snippets tonight.

jules: suggest two headline variants for A/B: 'Predictable LLM economics for production' and 'Keep inference fast under real traffic'.

ops-bot: reminder: set up registration page once copy + appendix link are ready.

lena: action items: jen appendix, sam routing + snippets, mike webinar ops, omar tone guide. due Tue EOD. I'll write the launch post after appendix. :thumbsup:
